description: Filesystem weight ceilings for the built public/ tree. Numbers consume S15/T69 outcomes (image weight after the adaptive ladder) with headroom; they are not invented Lighthouse score thresholds.
notes: Audio/video bodies are out of the image budget (a track recording is intentionally large).
search-index.json has its own ceiling in check-search-index.py.

CSS ceiling is temporarily 80 KiB (W0059 / DR-2026-046, owner approved 2026-10-25), raised from 72 KiB while the audio UI is completed. W0074 tracks the CSS audit and durable budget decision. Other ceilings are unchanged. Original T208 baseline was 67 746 bytes; the cap remains enforced against the complete CSS output.

Font ceiling is 256 KiB (T230, 2026-09-16): 219 500 bytes of published woff2 after Fira Code became one variable file per subset plus symbols and math subsets, headroom 42 644 bytes (19%). A small new subset fits; bringing back the 400/700 duplicate (+84 KB) or a whole new face set does not.

/sw.js is outside the JS ceiling by owner decision (T226, 2026-09-15): it does not block rendering and is fetched only on Service Worker registration. Since T227 it is the cleanup worker that retires that layer.
